title: Nonlinear Axiomatic Attribution for Cooperative Games
abstract: arXiv:2607.09869v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Shapley value is a widely used concept in attribution problems, as it uniquely satisfies the axioms of linearity, consistency, equal treatment, and efficiency. Often, the inclusion AUC metric is used to evaluate the quality of player rankings, in order to identify positively participating players. However, it can be established that the Shapley value is not always reliable for this purpose. The core issue lies in its linearity: the Shapley value acts as a linear operator with an excessively large null space, which is likely to contain non-negligible perturbations that remain indistinguishable to the operator. To address this limitation, we explore the design of nonlinear axiomatic attribution methods. Inspired by the least core, which is a popular nonlinear substitute for the Shapley value, we introduce a class of nonlinear attribution methods that retain the remaining necessary axioms. translated_title: 合作博弈中的非线性公理归因方法
translated_abstract: Shapley值是归因问题中广泛使用的概念，因为它唯一满足线性性、一致性、平等对待和效率等公理。通常，使用包含AUC指标来评估玩家排名的质量，以识别积极参与的玩家。然而，可以证明Shapley值在此目的上并不总是可靠的。核心问题在于其线性性：Shapley值作为一个线性算子，具有过大的零空间，其中可能包含非平凡的扰动，而这些扰动对算子来说无法区分。为了解决这一局限，我们探索了非线性公理归因方法的设计。受最小核心（一种流行的Shapley值非线性替代方案）启发，我们引入了一类非线性归因方法，这些方法保留了其余必要的公理。每种方法产生一个贡献向量，该向量...
tldr: 本文针对Shapley值在线性归因中的零空间缺陷，提出了一类基于最小核心启发的非线性公理归因方法，以更可靠地识别积极参与者。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the null-space limitation of Shapley value in linear attribution and introduces a class of nonlinear axiomatic attribution methods inspired by the least core to more reliably identify positively participating players.
